common.footer: You received this email because of activity on your GoYacht account.

welcome.subject: Welcome to GoYacht
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Browse our boats and book your next trip on the water.

booking_created.subject: Booking {{number}} is waiting for payment
booking_created.body: We are holding your booking until {{deadline}}. Complete the payment before then to confirm it.

booking_confirmed.subject: Booking {{number}} is confirmed
booking_confirmed.body: Your trip is confirmed. Your e-ticket is available from your account.

balance_reminder.subject: Balance due for booking {{number}}
balance_reminder.body: Please pay the remaining {{amount}} before {{deadline}}. Unpaid bookings are cancelled automatically and the deposit is forfeited.

booking_cancelled.subject: Booking {{number}} was cancelled
booking_cancelled.body: Your booking has been cancelled. Reason: {{reason}}.

trip_reminder.subject: Your trip departs tomorrow
trip_reminder.body: Booking {{number}} departs on {{departure}} from {{port}}. Please arrive 30 minutes early with your ID.

review_request.subject: How was your trip?
review_request.body: We would love to hear about your trip on {{boat}}. Your review helps other travellers.

admin_booking_created.subject: New booking {{number}}
admin_booking_created.body: A new booking was created for {{boat}} on {{departure}}.

admin_exception.subject: Payment exception for {{number}}
admin_exception.body: A payment of {{amount}} arrived for a booking that is {{status}}. Review it in the exception queue.
